title: Exploding Nebula Cluster
description: A luminous, fiery central mass of glowing orange and yellow light erupts outward, surrounded by thousands of scattered, colorful circular bokeh-like orbs in red, blue, green, and purple. The orbs drift against a dark, moody background of deep teal and black clouds, with golden sparks and faint wire-like lines visible within the explosion.
prompt: A dramatic explosion of glowing particles and colorful translucent orbs floating in a dark atmosphere, intense fiery orange and yellow core radiating outward with thousands of scattered red blue and green circular bokeh lights, dark teal and black cloudy background, sparks and thin golden lines, painterly impasto texture, moody and ethereal lighting, cinematic composition
